description: Every 30 minutes on weekdays, finds AP bills that have been entered in Xero but don't have their PDF attached yet, and attaches the stored PDF to the bill in the client's Xero organisation. It changes nothing else in Xero.

flowIr.description: Attaches each entered bill's PDF to the bill in the client's Xero organisation.
flowIr.name: Bookkeeping AP: Attach bill PDFs in Xero

outputs.description: Anything that went wrong, one per line.
outputs.name: problems

nodes.summary: For each AP bill entered in Xero without its PDF, finds the bill in the client's Xero and attaches the stored PDF.
nodes.title: Attach PDFs to entered bills

name: Bookkeeping AP: Attach bill PDFs in Xero
